title: Stop name as uppercase label
description: Stop name is uppercased with wide letter-spacing and reduced size, reading as a small label the way the board-header (Destino / Próxima salida) already does; destination headsigns stay plain sentence-case at normal size. Flips which tier carries the caps/label treatment, so the header recedes into a category tag and the destinations become the visually dominant content.

changes.intent: Treat the stop name as a small uppercase label rather than a large display heading, echoing the mono board-header labels.
Leave destinations in plain sentence case at full weight so they become the primary readable content once the header is demoted to a label.
